statement: Use the supported coefficient tensor source of [def-pur-supported-class-geometry] and the finite ordinary/pro-etale exact site comparison and its normalized closed-constant comparison of [lem-pur-supported-cup-functoriality]. Define the site transport of a derived representative into the degree-$n$ shift of $A_X(r)[0]$ by exact derived inverse image, its shift comparison, its degree-zero comparison, and the defining identification of the transported finite twist. Define transport of the tensor coefficient source by exact derived inverse image of its map to the ordinary supported unit, its degree-zero comparison and the normalized closed-constant isomorphism. Form the degree-zero and shifted-target composites in arbitrary abelian categories with exact functor before specializing to the finite sites.
